point: The massive success of Eat Pray Love led people to express constant fear that the author would never be able to top it.
quote: everywhere i go now people treat me like i'm doomed seriously doomed doomed like they come up to me now all worried

point: Modern society has dangerously normalized the assumption that creative work is intrinsically tied to mental anguish and suffering.
quote: we've completely internalized and accepted collectively this notion that creativity and suffering are somehow inherently linked

point: Ancient Greek and Roman cultures believed that creative inspiration came from external divine spirits rather than human beings themselves.
quote: ancient greece and ancient rome people did not happen to believe that creativity came from human beings back then

point: The Renaissance shifted the idea of genius into the individual, placing an overwhelming and destructive burden on the human psyche.
quote: for the first time in history you start to hear people referring to this or that artist as being a genius rather than having a genius

point: Poet Ruth Stone described creative inspiration as an external physical force rushing across the landscape that she had to catch.
quote: she would feel and hear a poem coming at her from over the landscape and she said it was like a thunderous train of air

point: Musician Tom Waits reduced his creative anxiety by choosing to treat inspiration as an external collaborator rather than an internal torment.
quote: realized that this didn't have to be this internalized tormented thing it could be this peculiar wondrous bizarre collaboration

point: Adopting an external view of genius allowed the author to push past despair while writing by simply committing to doing her share of the work.
quote: if you want it to be better then you've got to show up and do your part of the deal

point: Historically, moments of transcendent artistic brilliance were celebrated as glimpses of the divine rather than individual human accomplishment.
quote: when a performer has done something impossible and magic allah ole ole allah magnificent bravo incomprehensible there it is a glimpse of god

point: Viewing creative gifts as merely on loan protects artists from the devastating emotional crashes that follow transcendent moments.
quote: maybe if you just believed that they were on loan to you you know from some unimaginable source

point: Creators must overcome their fear and faithfully continue to show up for their work regardless of whether genius appears.
quote: don't be afraid don't be daunted just do your job continue to show up for your piece of it whatever that might be
